_note: US dollars to the euro: the ECB's reference rate of `date`, read by hand on `read` (Banca d'Italia's page for that day gives the same 1.1165). The ECB publishes it for information only, so a shop and a card convert at their own rates. Only sprue handoff reads it, for the euro figures in fab/order/; the quote stays in USD, and this file is not one of its inputs. Changing it makes fab/order/ out of date: run sprue handoff again.
